Data.subject: Transport
Data.title: Vessel Arrivals By Type, Annual
Data.datasource: MARITIME AND PORT AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE
Data.footnote: Refers to the number of vessels exceeding 75 Gross Tonnage that arrive at the Port of Singapore during the reference period.

row.footnote: Refers to a ship structured specifically to carry containers.
Refers to a ship designed to carry general goods in parcel or in bulk form.
Refers to a ship which is intended primarily to carry dry cargo in bulk, including such types as ore carriers and combination carriers.
Refers to a ship constructed or adapted primarily to carry oil or gas in bulk in its cargo spaces and includes combination carriers.
Refers to a ship which carries more than twelve passengers.
Refers to a long flat-bottomed boat for carrying cargo, either under its own power or towed by another.
Refers to a boat used for pushing or towing other vessels.
Refers to vessels not categorised as container, freighter, bulk carrier, tanker, passenger, barge or tug.
